mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6; prednisone may induce CYP3A4 leading to decreased tolterodine levels, while both drugs have anticholinergic effects that may be additive.
action: Monitor for reduced antimuscarinic efficacy of tolterodine; consider dose adjustment if needed and assess for excessive anticholinergic effects (urinary retention, constipation, dry mouth).
